findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_knowledge, get_entity, search, fetch, answer_sources · Private data: search_knowledge, get_entity, get_by_name, fetch, answer_sources, quest_page, world_map_near, entity_relations, item_categories, talent_tree, talent_plan, class_races, coverage, everloot_plan · Public sink: get_by_name, talent_tree, talent_plan, completion_progress, guild_rankings, auction_history, market_value, gold_ledger, population, recent_changes · Destructive: item_page, npc_page, entity_relations, guild_board, guild_rankings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_knowledge, get_entity, search, fetch, answer_sources · Private data: search_knowledge, get_entity, get_by_name, fetch, answer_sources, quest_page, world_map_near, entity_relations, item_categories, talent_tree, talent_plan, class_races, coverage, everloot_plan · Public sink: get_by_name, talent_tree, talent_plan, completion_progress, guild_rankings, auction_history, market_value, gold_ledger, population, recent_changes · Destructive: item_page, npc_page, entity_relations, guild_board, guild_rankings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
